name: marrvel-mcp-benchmark-data
description: A domain-specific benchmark dataset associated with the MARRVEL resource suite, prepared for benchmarking models on MCP-related prediction/annotation tasks. It is intended to evaluate model performance on specialized biomedical/genomic curation or prediction tasks derived from aggregated model-organism and human data. The data are targeted at tools used in variant/phenotype interpretation workflows.
reputation: Specialized dataset with niche adoption in bioinformatics and medical genomics communities; not broadly used outside those domains.
